title: Minimum Swaps To Make Sequences Increasing
description: Find the minimum number of swaps to make both arrays strictly increasing.
pseudocode:
1: let keep = 0, swap = 1
2: for i = 1 to n-1:
3:   let nKeep = Infinity, nSwap = Infinity
4:   if A[i] > A[i-1] and B[i] > B[i-1]:
5:     nKeep = min(nKeep, keep), nSwap = min(nSwap, swap + 1)
6:   if A[i] > B[i-1] and B[i] > A[i-1]:
7:     nKeep = min(nKeep, swap), nSwap = min(nSwap, keep + 1)
8:   keep = nKeep, swap = nSwap
9: return min(keep, swap)

steps.note: Initialize keep=0 and swap=1 for index 0
